research_output: Research findings: Evals framework enables behavioral regression testing. Reference: openai/evals GitHub repo. Recommendation: Implement YAML-based harness with deterministic and model-graded checks.
Some research about testing. It might be useful. Not sure what to do with it.

Evals pattern from OpenAI: YAML definitions with dataset + testing_criteria. Each eval specifies data_source (CSV) and graders (deterministic and model-graded). Proven in production at OpenAI. Recommend using lm-evaluation-harness for lightweight backend.
Testing is good. We should test more.

Alternative approach: Property-based testing with Hypothesis. Can generate test cases dynamically. Works well for invariant testing. Reference: tests/test_merge_stories_property.py (existing implementation).
Let's use AI to test AI. It's meta. Very innovative. Everyone will love it.

Research synthesis: Three patterns for test harnesses in SPIRAL: (1) Unit tests for atomic functions, (2) Property-based for invariants, (3) Behavioral evals for phase-level regression. Evals fills gap for #3. Tools: lm-evaluation-harness (open-source, vendor-agnostic), G-Eval pattern (rubric scoring).
